newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire minister says Mobutu-Kabila talks imminent.
newsitem.headline: Zaire minister says Mobutu-Kabila talks imminent.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila could meet shortly after negotiations between their envoys, Zaire's Information Minister Kin-Kiey Mulumba said on Wednesday.
"Things are getting clearer. Plans are afoot for a meeting between the head of state and the rebel leader. This meeting is imminent," Kin-Kiey told a news conference in the capital Kinshasa.
